name: She never walks off an edge, gets stuck or gets left behind
body: Dean: Q left her circling and sometimes jumping off the edge, F sent her to a switch and she never came back, she stuck on stairs and couldn't follow in Flow and fragile or the crossing. She walks only on ground (a down ray ahead of each step refuses an edge), recovers from being stuck or fallen by going back to the last safe beat and trying again, and as a last resort goes to the beat itself, so a level can't lock.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: An edge ahead stops her instead of dropping her
Stuck for two seconds: back to the last beat, retry, then straight to the beat on the third try
A fall below the last beat puts her back on it
